register.labelZh: COME DOWN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: COME DOWN Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: come down 可以表示前來探望某人,也可以表示從較高位置移到較低位置。；come down to 可以指出事情歸根結底取決於哪一個關鍵因素。；come down with 可用來表示某人開始患上感冒、流感或其他輕微疾病。；come down on 可以描述嚴厲批評或懲罰;come down to somebody from somebody 則可以表示某事物由上一代傳給某人。
register.summaryEn: Come down can describe travelling to see someone or moving from a higher place to a lower one. Come down to helps show the one point that matters most. Come down with is useful when someone begins to have a cold, flu or another mild illness. Come down on describes severe criticism or punishment, while come down to somebody from somebody shows that something was passed from an earlier generation.
